chunks: Ibn Muskan narrated from al-Halabi, who said:

I asked Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام about game that a man shoots with an arrow, and it strikes it sideways and kills it, while he had mentioned Allah's name over it when he shot, but the iron tip did not strike it.
So he عليه السلام said: "If the arrow that struck it is what killed it, then when he finds it, let him eat it."

key_terms.بِسَهْمٍ: with an arrow used for hunting
key_terms.سَمَّى: mentioned the name of Allah at the time of release
key_terms.مُعْتَرِضًا: sideways, without a direct piercing strike

ai.seo_question: Is hunted game halal if an arrow kills it without the iron tip penetrating?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a fiqh ruling on hunted game struck by an arrow in a non-penetrating manner. If the animal died due to that arrow itself, and Allah's name had been mentioned at the time of shooting, then it is permissible to eat it.
